evidence.reason: The denylist workflow invokes gitleaks with a trusted TOML config but leaves a PR-controlled `.gitleaksignore` in the scanned checkout. Gitleaks' source-local ignore file can suppress a finding by fingerprint, so a PR can add a prohibited value plus its ignore entry and pass the required denylist check. This is an implementation error in the existing fail-closed denylist behavior, not a new protection requirement; no accepted limitation covers PR-controlled ignore overrides.
